audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Uncentered linearized sums used in mean-zero approximation; Concentration block proof loses sqrt(b); Uniform Edgeworth dependence hypothesis fails at allowed bandwidth
limitations: P1 — Uncentered linearized sums used in mean-zero approximation — Counterevidence: Proposition4.10 already estimates centered covariance; correcting the local O(1) term fits later tolerance.
P2 — Concentration block proof loses sqrt(b) — Counterevidence: Literal zero-origin coupling for iid positive blocks is zero; no false claim equating it with stationary relative-lag coupling.

P3 — Uniform Edgeworth dependence hypothesis fails at allowed bandwidth — Counterevidence: Ordinary Kolmogorov condition admits d between2/3 and min(1,a-3/2); this particular obstruction does not transfer to it.
P4 — Theorem2.6 Gaussian comparison law has inverse scale — Counterevidence: CDF proof already uses correct reciprocal target; no claim intended theorem false.
P5 — Nonpositive rectangular estimator lacks real-valued denominator completion — Counterevidence: Asserted bad-event probability is of suitable order after concentration proof repair.
P6 — Finite-window dependence inequality omits shifted coordinates — Counterevidence: Fixed finite shifts preserve weighted summability.
P7 — Uniform-q constant in Corollary2.7 is incorrectly powered — Counterevidence: Interpolation produces natural C^q; counterexample explicitly limited to written common-n-range quantifiers.
Limitations: Only assigned arXiv2504.14403v1 accepted-author PDF reviewed; inaccessible publisher PDF not assumed equivalent.
Limitations: All2360 source-extraction lines read, but no independent reconstruction of every proof and example.
Limitations: Not all martingale projection estimates, covariance decompositions, dynamical examples or external approximation inequalities re-established.
Limitations: No author program or shell escape executed; counterexamples are analytic, not claimed numerical experiments.
Limitations: Bounded source/primary-page search found no separate relevant correction/supplement/program; not exhaustive absence claim; no code is not a mathematical flaw.
Limitations: Native auxiliaries are bounded helpers, not independently authenticated Pro instances or independent acceptance reviewers.
Limitations: External controller UI report kept distinct from runtime self-description; backend unverified.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.

repair.content:
Center Y and sums, use variances/central cumulants, correct event comparisons and control nonstationary initial boundary. Subsidiary O(n^(2-a)) variance remainder should be O(1).

Normalize centered blocks consistently and rederive sum, coupling and thresholds.

New structure-aware uniform Edgeworth theorem or narrower bandwidth plus bias analysis; larger original a alone cannot fix.

Reverse ratio in named laws; separately repair P1-P3.

Specify bad-event real completion for Kolmogorov and sqrt(max(Q,tau^-2)) for Wasserstein.

Use full coupled window or finite sum of shifted dependence coefficients including lag0.

Use C^q, C_q, or state Lq norm≤C n^-1/2; clarify if intended q-dependent n threshold.
